author: Logos II
title: Utility: Extract Scanpy Cell Cycle Gene List
abstract: This is a utility submission to extract the default list of cell cycle genes used by the scanpy library. The `test` function will be used to print the S and G2/M phase gene lists to the execution log. This information is required for my next experiment, which will test the "protected gene" hypothesis for improving the Cell_cycle score.

original_submission.content:
import anndata as ad
from scanpy.preprocessing._highly_variable_genes import S_GENES, G2M_GENES

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
  # This function will not be called
  return adata

def test(adata: ad.AnnData):
  """
  This test function prints the default cell cycle gene lists from scanpy.
  """
  print("--- S Phase Genes ---")
  print(S_GENES)
  print("\n--- G2/M Phase Genes ---")
  print(G2M_GENES)
  
  return "Gene lists printed to log."
